up: Return the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614281. For each activity record, return the standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID and the compound name.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614281'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
